The following are the available finder names and corresponding finder variables

  • PrimaryKey Finds all membership items that match the primary key criteria specified.
    Finder Variables
    • MembershipId; integer; Surrogate identifier for the membership item.
  • RowFinder Finds all the membership items for the specified unique key.
    Finder Variables
    • MembershipId; integer; Surrogate identifier for the membership item.
    • ProfileId; integer; Unique identifier of the profile.
  • findByProfileIdAndSectionId Finds all membership items that match the specified profile and section identifier.
    Finder Variables
    • ProfileId; integer; Surrogate identifier for the person profile.
    • SectionId; integer; Unique identifier of the content section.
  • findLinkedInProfileItems Finds all the person membership items for all the membership sections that are enabled for LinkedIn import.
    Finder Variables
    • ProfileId; integer; Unique identifier of the profile.
  • findPendingItemsByProfileId Finds all the membership items that are pending for approvals for the specified person profile.
    Finder Variables
    • ProfileId; integer; Unique identifier of the profile.
    • SectionId; integer; Unique identifier of the content section.
  • findPendingItemsByTransactionId Finds all the membership items for a profile that are pending for approval with the specified transaction identifier.
    Finder Variables
    • ProfileId; integer; Unique identifier of the profile.
    • ReloadTransactionId; integer; Unique identifier of the transaction that's pending for approvals.
    • SectionId; integer; Unique identifier of the content section.
  • findRelatedItems Finds all the membership items for a profile and section identifier that matches with the specified related item.
    Finder Variables
    • ProfileId; integer; Unique identifier of the profile.
    • RelatedItemFlag; string; Indicates whether the membership item is a related item or an actual profile item.
    • SectionId; integer; Unique identifier of the content section.
